content:
**Love the Spread**, formerly **Expert Shotgunner**, is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Weapons that fire 3 or more have increased range.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Weapons that fire 3 or more projectiles gain 30% range. | 001447AC | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Expert Shotgunner." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to shotguns.
